changelog: - **The deploy-time org backfill now covers every `orgId` column, not six of them** (#1557). `prisma/backfill-organization.mjs` hardcoded six models while 23 carry an `orgId`; the 15 nullable ones outside that list (`ApiKey`, `AccountLockout`, `CompanyInquiry`, `InterviewPanel`, `InvitationToken`, `MatchFeedback`, `MentorApplication`, `MessageTemplate`, `Offer` and the original six) stayed `NULL` — and under `MT_ENFORCE_ISOLATION=true` the Prisma middleware injects `where: { orgId }` into every tenant-model query, so a `NULL` row matches nobody and vanishes from the product. The model list is now derived from `Prisma.dmmf.datamodel.models` instead of being hand-maintained, so it cannot drift from `prisma/schema.prisma` again; models whose `orgId` is `NOT NULL` are skipped (they cannot hold NULLs) and logged as such, `Setting` is excluded on purpose because its `NULL` rows are the global fallback layer that applies to every tenant, and the script re-counts after the pass and **exits non-zero if any nullable `orgId` is still NULL**, so a partial backfill can no longer pass silently. The deploy keeps `|| true` (pending the #1540 backfill registry) but now prints a loud warning instead of swallowing the failure, and `docs/tenant-isolation.md` records a complete backfill as step 1 of the enforcement rollout.
